blocks.text: The Zscaler UVM and Arnica Deployment Guide provides instructions on using Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) with the Arnica Security platform.

UVM ingests, normalizes, and unifies data across enterprise security and business systems to deliver actionable insights, analytics, and operational efficiencies. UVM offers an Arnica Miconfigs preconfigured Arnica connector, which retrieves misconfigurations in your projects.
